name: Ryouchi Kizoku
source:
Siegfried is the fourth son from a small poor noble family who won some land thanks to his battle contributions. He founded a new Maired clan and ruled over a vast territory in the southern part of the kingdom. He thought that it would be a pleasant and relaxing life, but he wasn’t ready for the amount of work that was involved. Of course, there’s lots of paperwork and required appearances, but also having to answer to faction requests, making babies and naming a future successor? Everything was new to him and the only people to help him was the daughter of a ruined noble family, a knight who had been dismissed with dishonour, and a high-class prostitute. He didn’t know if they could be relied on, but nevertheless he takes his first step towards successfully managing his territory.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2017/08/01/august-2017-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
齐格弗里德是贫穷小贵族家的第四子，因战功获得了一片土地。他建立新的迈雷德家族，统治王国南部的广阔领土。他以为这会是愉快轻松的生活，却没准备好迎接随之而来的工作量。

当然，他需要处理大量文件、出席必要场合，还要回应派系请求、制造孩子并指定继承人。一切都很新鲜，唯一能帮助他的，是没落贵族家的女儿、因耻辱被解雇的骑士，以及高级妓女。

他不知道能否依靠她们，但仍迈出成功管理领地的第一步。

[来源：[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2017/08/01/august-2017-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
